description: FlexJobs remote and flexible jobs for a job title or category (e.g. 'developer', 'customer-service', 'writing'): title, summary, allowed locations, remote level, schedule, salary range, benefits, categories, posted and expiry dates, plus the total count. From flexjobs.com's public listing pages via a residential proxy. FlexJobs hides employer names from non-members, so company is not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

category.description: Job title or category slug as in flexjobs.com/remote-jobs/<slug>, e.g. 'developer', 'data-entry', 'marketing'
